title: Ending a Bed Hold: Return, Release, Expiry and Readmission
content:
**Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations — how a hold ends.**

A resident who returns while the hold is in force goes back to the same room, which is never assigned to anyone else during the hold. A release is the resident's or representative's own decision, needs no advance notice and stops charges after the day of release. A hold expires when payer-covered days are used up with no private extension, when the hospital discharges the resident to another setting, when the private hold maximum is reached without a renewal, or for an unpaid private hold. A private hold is ended for nonpayment only when a charge is at least the unpaid hold past-due days past due and the unpaid-hold notice was delivered at least the unpaid hold release notice days before, counted in calendar days with the day after delivery as day 1. After a hold ends, a Medicaid-eligible resident returns to the first available bed in a semi-private room and any other resident to the next available bed; if the center will not readmit, it must issue a facility-initiated discharge notice. For a skilled stay, a return within the Part A interrupted-stay window resumes the same skilled stay.

### Ending a private hold for nonpayment — the time test

Both parts must hold, on the system's records for that reservation: a charge at least the unpaid hold past-due days past due (30 on every tier), and an unpaid-hold notice recorded as delivered at least the unpaid hold release notice days before (7 calendar days on every tier). The count starts the calendar day after the delivery date, which is day 1; the test is met on the day the count reaches 7, and on every later day.

| Unpaid-hold notice delivered | Day counted | Notice test |
|---|---|---|
| on a hypothetical 9th | the 15th is day 6 | not met |
| on a hypothetical 9th | the 16th is day 7 | met |
| on a hypothetical 9th | the 20th is day 11 | met |

### The four expiries

| Hold expires because… |
|---|
| payer-covered days are used up and no private extension was elected |
| the hospital discharges the resident to another setting |
| the private hold maximum is reached without a written renewal |
| a private hold is unpaid, the time test above being met |

### Where the resident returns

| Situation | Bed |
|---|---|
| return while the hold is in force | the same room |
| return after the hold ended, Medicaid-eligible resident | first available bed in a semi-private room |
| return after the hold ended, any other resident | next available bed |
| the center will not readmit | facility-initiated discharge notice must be issued |
